description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

No-LN 3-layer circuit: prev-char attention builds char bigrams; hyp bigrams matched against premise bigrams (sep as null) give overlap F; 'no'/"n'" bigram gives negation N; readout argmax(A*F, A*(1-F), K*N).
Bigram-overlap circuit (v1 features, no LN) with entail/neutral threshold moved to F>0.6 (logit0=A(F-0.6), logit1=A(0.6-F)); contradiction via 'no'/"n'" negation.
